Does this change how a block that shows or picks media looks or behaves for the people who use it? This includes choosing, uploading, replacing, cropping or editing an image, video or audio file from the block, and how the block displays that media. Such blocks include Image, Gallery, Cover, Media & Text, Video, Audio, File, Post Featured Image, Site Logo and Playlist, and the shared media controls in `packages/block-library/src/utils`. Answer no when what people see and do stays the same, such as for a dependency update, a type change or a test change that keeps the same runtime behavior.
